description: This Java class 'ImmutableLoggerConfig' provides an immutable implementation of the 'LoggerConfig' interface. It allows creation, serialization, and deserialization of logger configuration objects, including properties like log level and optional logger name. It also contains methods for JSON parsing and object comparison.

classes.name: ImmutableLoggerConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the LoggerConfig interface, providing methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new LoggerConfig instance with a specified log level and optional logger name.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a LoggerConfig instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level of this configuration.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the logger name if set.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the LoggerConfig to a JSON object adhering to a specific schema version.
